query:
UPDATE email_send_logs SET status = $2,
            provider_message_id = COALESCE($3, provider_message_id),
            error_message = COALESCE(left($4, 255), error_message),
            sent_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'accepted' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END,
            updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
